title: README final precision before the tag (handoff GCLI-57 items a to g, plus DEC-299 a6 limit)
description: The handoff's reserved GCLI-57. implementationNotes: Aliases the handoff's reserved GCLI-57 (the id was not assignable). Items done 2026-11-23 on docs/GCLI-57-readme-final: result/success envelope wording and the stderr rule (envelope under --json and --stream, plain message otherwise, verified by running both); parity bullet cut to one sentence; --plain parenthetical dropped; indeterminate wording names a failed git read, a refused repository and the (a5) empty read after one retry; code-map example origin/main; impact example now shows a cold-cache run and is pinned by a test in test/impact.test.ts (mutated README line turns it red); Limits sentence for non-UTF-8/NFD names per DEC-299 a6 (follow-up GCLI-64, held); src/program.ts docstring matches README and src/stream.ts. src/stream.ts lines 10-12 already match and are unchanged. Checks: bun run check 265 pass, lore check (0.14.1) 0 errors.

2026-11-23 Opus review APPROVE on the wording (head 08a3522) with a landing gate: at the 4cf670e base nothing in src/ retries, so the README's empty-read retry sentences and the Limits bullet (a mangled pathspec exits 0 there, not 7) are false until glyph-cli#112 (GCLI-56) lands; this task lands after it, rebased, with bun run check and the impact test re-run on the rebased SHA (the 265 pass was measured without #112). DEPENDENCY: on GCLI-56. The quest edge cannot be set on this branch because the GCLI-56 record is not on dev yet; add it with 'quest task edit GCLI-65 --add-dependency GCLI-56' at the rebase. Review nits applied: only git's own timeout gives exit 7 while a wall-time-budget cut is the time-budget omission with exit 0; the Limits bullet now says a changed source file that reaches the line-range read, and 'a Unicode name stored decomposed (NFD), as on macOS'. PUBLISH-ORDER CONDITION for the operator checklist, not a README change: the ADR links point at /blob/main/ in a repository private until release, so main must carry the ADRs and the repository must be public before or at publish.
